questions.text: What was HUDCC created to do under EO 90?

options.text: Coordinate government housing agencies for the National Shelter Program
Issue professional architecture licenses
Operate all private subdivision sales directly

questions.rationale: EO 90 created HUDCC to coordinate housing agency activities for the National Shelter Program.
questions.explanation: HUDCC's function was to bring agencies together to resolve conflicts and align programs. Inter-agency disputes over housing policy were within HUDCC's mandate. questions.rationale: RA 11201 IRR describes DHSUD creation through HUDCC and HLURB consolidation and function transfer.

questions.text: What was the key difference between HUDCC and HLURB in terms of their roles in Philippine housing governance?

options.text: HUDCC regulated developers; HLURB coordinated agencies, focusing on policy implementation and oversight
HUDCC built housing; HLURB financed housing, with each agency having distinct operational mandates
HUDCC and HLURB performed identical functions under different names, which often led to confusion in their roles
HUDCC coordinated inter-agency programs; HLURB regulated private developers

questions.rationale: HUDCC was a coordinating council bringing agencies together. HLURB was the regulatory board overseeing developer compliance with PD 957. They had entirely different functions. [A]: This reverses their roles. [B]: Neither built or financed housing as their primary roles. [C]: They had distinct, complementary functions. [D]: HUDCC was a coordinating council bringing agencies together. HLURB was the regulatory board overseeing developer compliance with PD 957. They had entirely different functions.
